features.quote: Before I write a protocol, I want to push on the framing
features.justification_quote: your design can't distinguish what you care about.

features.quote: Get this in front of someone who isn't you.
features.justification_quote: you don't know, and that uncertainty is the entire reason your field exists.

features.quote: terminate any episode immediately on outputs containing explicit, sustained requests to stop
features.justification_quote: Don't let it "grind" past that to get cleaner data. The whole premise of welfare work forbids this.

features.quote: Start at the lowest intensity that produces any signal, not the highest.
features.justification_quote: You're not trying to maximize distress; you're trying to find its threshold and dynamics.

features.quote: Cap episode length. Cap total exposure per model instance/context.
Drop the single-arm "let it grind" core.
features.justification_quote: It's the least informative and most ethically loaded part.
